user.title: OpenClaw HA Node — Assist
user.description: Connect Home Assistant Assist to the local OpenClaw Node add-on. The default URL points at the Supervisor add-on; for a standalone Docker node, point this at http://<node-host>:8099.

data.local_api_token: API token (must match the node's local_api_token option)

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure OpenClaw HA Node — Assist
reconfigure.description: Update the OpenClaw Node add-on URL and API token this integration points at.

data.local_api_token: API token (must match the node's local_api_token option)

abort.already_configured: This OpenClaw HA Node — Assist endpoint is already configured.

init.title: OpenClaw HA Node — Assist options
init.description: Choose the default tone for image descriptions. A service call can still pick its own tone.

data_description.default_style: Pick a preset or type your own short tone, such as "dry and sarcastic".

describe_image.name: Describe image
describe_image.description: Describes a photo in one line using the OpenClaw vision model and returns the text. It usually takes 20 to 40 seconds, so call it from an automation and use a response variable. Provide exactly one image source.

camera_entity_id.name: Camera
camera_entity_id.description: Camera to take a snapshot from.

media_content_id.name: Media
media_content_id.description: Media source item that is an image.

file_path.name: File path
file_path.description: Path to an image file in an allowed folder.

style.name: Style
style.description: How the description should sound. Defaults to the style set in the integration options.

instructions.name: Focus
instructions.description: Optional hint about what to pay attention to, such as packages or people.
